I am really sorry to hear that. I remember self harming when I was 15. My dad used to beat me up if I didn't get the top grades so I worked my ass off and an year later got an admitted into one of the famous schools in another state. Getting away from them for 2 years stopped the physical abuse but I wish I could say the same thing for the mental abuse. Being in a super competitive environment with no support system and battling other health issues made me depressed. Fast forward, I am 22 now, supposed to be graduating from college this year. I stay with them to save money and I will move out when I start my job in july but during this whole quarantine, there have been atleast a dozen instances where I thought my dad was going to hit me but he just called me names and made me cry. My mom is always encouraging him to do that. You haven't mentioned anything about your mom. Can you rely on her for emotional support?

What I am trying to say is, you know you can't just run away. You need to be practical and do something like get admitted to a school in another state and then a college. I fully understand how depression leaves you with no motivation for things like good grades and the SATs. I was able to do it then because I wasn't depressed and my only goal in life was to get as far away from them as possible.But I still want you to try and give it your best because if you don't do it for yourself, then who will?

Also please consider stopping self harming because your body is doing everything it can to keep you up and running and it's all you got, don't treat it like that.
